idea: Move colored reticle shapes on a 64x64 pixel grid so their non-transparent pixels cover every matching target center. Direction actions move the selected reticle exactly 3 pixels, Space cycles selection, and the selected reticle is marked by a temporary white center pixel that is not part of any target. Targets are small dark frames with colored centers; only the center pixels matter, extra reticle pixels are allowed, and overlapping reticles can hide earlier pixels if drawn later. Levels should teach single-reticle alignment, multiple reticles, crosses and hollow shapes, overlap ordering, off-camera partial placement, recolor or transform pads, and final boards where all target centers must be covered without occluding needed colors.
title: Reticle
